text: Telegram needs every route as a clickable button, sectioned under HOME, with search routes connected and many sims. Dual-mirror each seed into MAIN (exact UTF-8 VITAFEED) and NEW (snark-short ZK) to learn which engine is cheaper/faster. Attach Basescan Input Data → UTF-8 IDM of hardcoded anchors as static proof — readable no matter how many txs/blobs once snark-compressed. Paid gates stay confirm|override. Never invent hashes. Message-first formula.

hypothesis.note: Sectioned inline keyboards + /home sim/engines seed learn while mirroring MAIN↔NEW; IDM anchors prove existence without inventing tx hashes.
